title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2607.10923v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the collective relaxation spectrum, thereby modifying memory self-energy, long-memory dynamics, and collective susceptibility through the infrared organization of slow relaxation modes. Here we test this framework directly in Transformer dynamics. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra from layer Jacobians throughout training, prompt ensembles, network depth, and model scale, allowing the collective observables of Cognitive Field Theory to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal pronounced infrared reorganization of the relaxation spectrum. translated_title: 变压器动力学中的红外组织与关键认知场形成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型表现出显著的涌现行为，但其集体动力学的物理机制仍知之甚少。认知场理论预测，学习会重组集体弛豫谱，从而通过慢弛豫模式的红外组织来修改记忆自能、长时记忆动力学和集体敏感性。我们直接在变压器动力学中检验了这一框架。利用公开可用的Pythia语言模型，我们从训练过程中的层雅可比矩阵、提示集成、网络深度和模型规模中提取弛豫谱，从而定量测量认知场理论的集体观测量。测量结果揭示了弛豫谱的显著红外重组。学习过程大幅重新分配了谱权重，同时保持近似平坦但弱红外增强的时间尺度密度。
tldr: 本研究通过测量变压器动力学中的弛豫谱，证实了学习导致慢弛豫模式的红外重组，形成关键认知场，从而定量验证了认知场理论。
en_tdlr: This study measures relaxation spectra in Transformer dynamics, confirming that learning induces infrared reorganization of slow modes to form a critical cognitive field, quantitatively validating Cognitive Field Theory.
